name: Franklin Country Day Camp
description_short: A day camp on 250 acres in Franklin, MA, with forest trails, fields, a stream, a pond and two pools, for children from entering kindergarten through grade 6. Camp runs 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. in two-week sessions, with archery, boating, Red Cross swimming, arts and crafts, ceramics, music, theater, woodworking and woodlore, and no cell phones or gaming devices.
swim_waterfront_notes: The camp has two inground swimming pools for its Red Cross swim program; Jr. Camp swimming lessons are taught by Red Cross accredited instructors. There is also a pond and a natural stream, and boating is an activity.
